description: Read-only lookup of a single entry by its ID; it changes nothing and performs no activity. Returns current field values, state, audit metadata, and the names of the activities available on it (to perform one, use get_form then submit_activity).

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Omit if set via env or set_workspace; required in stateless/remote mode.
